{{Boss}}[[Boss]] |immunities = Regular: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Chillness}}Chillness *{{Freeze|Freeze Defense Dropping}}Freeze Defense Dropping *[[File:SledgerLevel2.png|20px|Sledger Ice Breaker]][[Sledger]] Ice Breaker {{Boss}}[[Boss]]: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Partial Chillness}}Partial Chillness Towers & Units: *{{Freeze|Enemy Freeze}}Enemy Freeze |sandbox = No |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|Freeze.png|No Freeze}} }} ==Description== '''Freeze Immunity''' (with its tag referring to it as "''No Freeze''") is an immunity that prevents the enemy from being frozen and chilled. For towers and units, it prevents them from being frozen. ==Mechanics== '''Freeze Immunity''' makes it so that the enemy cannot be frozen. Additionally, it stops the enemy from being chilled by them. Because of its chillness immunity, it also prevents the enemies from having their defense dropped by freezing towers. Additionally, as the [[Sledger]] deals double damage to frozen or chilled enemies, it cannot deal double damage to them. Larger enemies are also frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these freeze based effects to '''Freeze Immune''' enemies: *[[Freezer]] *[[Frost Blaster]] *[[Sledger]] *[[Jester]] *[[Cryomancer]] *[[Snowballer]] *[[Elementalist]] *[[Blizzard Bomb]] *[[Pumpkin Bomb]] *[[Santa's Air Strike]] *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Ice Ducky]]) '''Freeze Immunity''' is given to all [[Boss]] enemies, though that immunity is different from the regular one. Both version are immune to being frozen, however, it is only partially immune to chillness. It is slowed down less by chillness, but it is not immune to it. This means that bosses can have their defense dropped and can be dealt double damage to by the [[Sledger]], as long as the enemy does not have the regular '''Freeze Immunity'''. '''Freeze Immunity''' also used to prevent enemies from being slowed down from frost mark while it was still in the game. While the [[Freezer]] dealt splash damage, it could not freeze any enemy with [[Splash Damage Immunity]]. However, these enemies could still be frozen by the [[Frost Blaster]] or through its ''Ice Age'' ability. Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], there was an additional type of '''Freeze Immunity''', referred to as '''Basic Freeze'''. These enemies could not be frozen by the [[Freezer]]'s main attack, but could be frozen through its ''Ice Drop'' ability. ===Towers=== Certain towers and units also have the '''Freeze Immunity''', which prevents them from being frozen, though it does not prevent them from being targeted. An [[Unstable Ice]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] will still target a freeze immune [[Molten Monster]], even though it not only deals no damage but also does not freeze it. ==Enemy List== The following enemies have '''Freeze Immunity''': *[[Hazmat]] *[[Fallen Hazmat]] *[[Elite Hazmat]] *[[Elite Molten]] *[[Tanker]] *[[Molten Summoner]] *[[Giant Boss]] *[[Summoner Boss]] *[[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]] (Legacy version) *[[Hazardous]] *[[Amalgamation]] (Modern version) *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] (Modern [[Polluted Wasteland II]] version) *[[Abomination]] (Legacy version) *[[Super Toxic]] (Modern version) *[[Necromancer King]] *[[Nuclear Guardian]] *[[Conjurer]] *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] *[[Cavalry]] (Modern version) *[[Patient Zero]] *[[Awakened Fallen King]] *[[Molten Hazmat]] *[[Blizzard Wizard]] *[[Frost Ravager]] (With shield) *[[Deep Freeze]] *[[Frost Necromancer]] *[[Frost Champion]] *[[Void Reaper]] *[[Mandragora]] *[[Slow King]] (Modern version, with Forcefield) *[[Crystalian]] *[[Void Trickster]] *[[Void Portal]] *[[Void Cultist]] *[[Healing Beacon]] *[[Void Eye]] *[[Void Knight]] *[[Void Guardian]] *[[Golden Mystery]] All [[Boss]] enemies have their own variant of '''Freeze Immunity''', as part of being a [[Boss]] enemy. The [[Medic]] can also apply '''Freeze Immunity''' to targeted towers and itself using the ''Ubercharge'' ability. ==Update History== *'''14 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.0|BETA v1.0.0]] **'''Freeze Immunity''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Freeze Immunity''' now prevents the enemy from being slowed down by frost mark. **'''Basic Freeze Immunity''' no longer exists, now only the regular '''Freeze Immunity''' exists. **'''Freeze Immunity''' is now given to all [[Boss]] enemies. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **No longer makes enemies immune to frost mark as it has been removed. **Now displayed with the {{AttrTag|First|Freeze.png|ICE}} tag under the enemy's health. *'''7 April 2023''' - [[v1.7.0]] **Tag displayed under an enemy's health bar changed from {{AttrTag|First|Freeze.png|ICE}} to {{AttrTag|Second|Freeze.png|No Freeze}}. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **Regular '''Freeze Immunity''' now makes the enemy immune to chillness slowdown, [[Boss]] '''Freeze Immunity''' only makes the slowdown weaker. **Regular '''Freeze Immunity''' now prevents freeze defense dropping, as it is now done through chillness. **{{Bug}} '''Freeze Immunity''' does not interact properly with freeze and chillness. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Freeze Immunity''' for towers and units added. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **Tower '''Freeze Immunity''' is now displayed in the upgrade menu. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **Flying enemies should no longer have '''Freeze Immunity'''. **{{Bug}} Flying enemies still have '''Freeze Immunity'''. *'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Flying]] enemies no longer have '''Freeze Immunity'''. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Freeze Immunity''' now interacts properly with freeze and chillness. {{AttributeNavBox}}
